items.headline: Markets (wk of Sep 28): Nasdaq closed at a record ~30,808 (QQQ ~$753) and S&P 500 ~flat-to-up on the week (+0.2%) after a soft September jobs report cooled Fed-hike fears; 10-yr Treasury eased toward ~5.25% (30-yr ~5.63%), markets pricing Fed on hold in October

Crunchbase: 40%+ of all 2026 seed & Series A dollars have gone to $100M+ rounds; this week Rhoda AI emerged from stealth with a $450M Series A (robotic intelligence), Nexthop AI raised $500M Series B (AI switching infra), Ricursive Intelligence a $300M Series A at $4B

OpenAI DevDay (Sep 29): 20+ announcements incl. 'Dots' always-on persistent agents (each with a cloud computer), a ChatGPT Apps platform letting devs build native apps for ~1.2B weekly users, an Agents API with computer use, and GPT-6.1 Sol; Altman/Friar discussed an eventual IPO
Anthropic shipped Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Sep 28) and took Claude for Government to general availability at FedRAMP High (Sep 30), opening the regulated public-sector market
Varda Space raised a $251M Series D (Sep 30) to scale in-space manufacturing and orbital-return vehicles (microgravity pharma crystallization, hypersonic re-entry testing)
Cornelis Networks raised $205M for high-performance networking for AI/HPC workloads — interconnect/switching as its own fundable category in the AI buildout

Jeeves raised $110M equity as a stablecoin-native banking platform; rhymes with YC's new option to take up to $500K of its investment in stablecoins — crypto rails becoming default startup-finance infra

Humanoid race now a data/deployment race: Tesla ramping Optimus toward ~1,000 units/week with a factory-work reveal expected this fall; Figure past 10,000 partner deployments; Sam Altman says OpenAI 'will definitely do a humanoid'
Vertical AI kept pulling checks: Trase raised $107M seed for an AI operating system for healthcare; Confido raised a $55M Series B (Insight, YC, Footwork) for AI-powered commercial operations

Learn: 'a16z and the Architecture of AI Capital (2026 Edition)' — how a16z's thesis shifted from 'software is eating the world' to 'AI is eating software' and reorganized its deployment and US-China framing

Learn: 2026 cognitive-offloading evidence (systematic review of ChatGPT in higher ed; MIT Media Lab follow-on; Michelle Miller 'Critical Thinking, Creative Thinking, and AI,' Oct 1) — scaffolded AI use protects thinking, unstructured use erodes it; FAU teaching material
Cycling: Il Lombardia (Oct 10) — season's fifth and final Monument, 239km Bergamo to Como, start list with Pogacar (chasing a 6th straight), Evenepoel, van der Poel, Vingegaard

Markets (wk of Sep 21): US equities ground higher despite a bond selloff — S&P 500 ~7,743, Nasdaq ~27,069; 10-yr Treasury ~5.18% (highest since GFC, 30-yr ~5.48%); oil slid toward $92; Fed stayed hawkish (Williams: another hike by year-end 'reasonable'), Oct hike odds ~70%
Cyera raised a $400M Series G extension at a $12B+ valuation (Sep 22, Goldman Sachs Alternatives) — AI/data-security control plane; 2026 fundraising past ~$1.4B, total >$2.7B
Island raised a $400M Series F at a $6.4B valuation (Sep 24, led by Evolution Equity Partners) — enterprise browser + AI-governance layer; more than doubled its 2024 mark

Anthropic shipped Claude Opus 5.5 (Sep 22) — first of a new 5.5 family; matches Fable 5.1 on most work at ~40% lower run-cost ($4/$20 per M tokens), ~30% faster output, leads Terminal-Bench/OSWorld agentic benchmarks

Figure unveiled Helix 2.5 (Sep 17; Forbes Sep 21) — robots completed chores in 30 unseen homes at 56% zero-shot (6x jump from 9%), the entire gain traced to training on 'Index,' its ~$1B crowdsourced human-activity dataset
Enveda raised a $311M Series E (Sep 23) for AI drug discovery — from Catalio, Durable Capital, ICONIQ, Lightspeed, Surveyor
Precision Neuroscience raised a $250M Series D (Sep 24), co-led by Ackman's Pershing Square (total ~$430M) — funds FDA review of its Layer 7 cortical brain-computer interface
Rightway raised a $155M Series E (Sep 24) — healthcare-navigation/PBM platform led by Francisco Partners with Thrive Capital and Khosla; serves 45 Fortune 500 employers, scaling AI features
Y Combinator will now let batch companies take their standard investment in stablecoins (up to $500K) instead of fiat — a structural signal for early-stage deal mechanics / crypto rails
OpenAI released GPT-6 Luna and GPT-6 Sol (Sep 22), two new variants following GPT-6 Astra — extending GPT-6 into a task-tiered family, competing on price/latency segmentation

Agent-native tools shipped: Ando exited stealth (~$20M) as team-messaging where AI agents are first-class participants (Sep 24), and Strada shipped agent record/replay automation inside legacy portals with audit logs (Sep 24)

Markets (wk of Sep 14): Fed hiked 25bps to 3.75-4.00% on Sep 16 — first hike in 3 years, unanimous, dot plot signals one more hike in 2026; Nasdaq +2.6% (~26,523), S&P 500 +0.7% (~7,650), Dow -733 pts; 10-yr Treasury briefly above 5.0%
Profound raised $180M Series D at ~$1.8B valuation (Sep 15), co-led by Sequoia and Kleiner Perkins — 'answer engine optimization' (AEO), measuring/shaping brand visibility inside AI answer engines

Anthropic disclosed (Sep 17-18) that Claude now LEADS ~26% of its own model R&D (up from 0% in February), completing tasks end-to-end from a high-level prompt under human supervision; ~90% of R&D done 'in collaboration' with Claude

OpenAI (Sep 17) published a formal framework for tracking/probing/disclosing model 'misalignment' and named six reports of concerning behavior; separately began testing 'Sponsored Agents' ads in ChatGPT

Temporal raised $550M Series E at a $12.55B valuation (Sep 14), led by Lightspeed — 'durable execution' reliability infra for agentic AI; ~$250M ARR (+200% YoY); customers OpenAI, Cursor, Netflix, JPMorgan

Factory raised $200M at a $5B valuation (Sep 15) from Blackstone, Khosla, Sequoia (angels Gerstner, Benioff) — 'self-improving software factories' for enterprise engineering; tripled valuation in five months
Cognition (Devin) hit a $48B valuation on ~$900M run-rate and Harvey (legal AI) reached $15.5B ($550M, Sep 9) — application-layer AI companies priced at foundation-model scale
